tools.name: search_news
tools.description: Search Pure Report's neutral, bias-scored news. Returns articles with neutral summaries in our own words; bias_score (0-100) rates the ORIGINAL source reporting (0 = wire-neutral, 100 = advocacy), NOT the returned summary, which is neutral by design. Each result also lists the event(s) it belongs to

tools.name: trending_events
tools.description: List the news events with the most current coverage activity. Each event clusters many outlets' articles about one story and includes headline (the published story's headline, else the event name), has_story (get_event returns Pure Report's neutral news story) and has_account (get_event also returns

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: Get the full neutral writeup of one news event by slug: 'story', Pure Report's own neutral news story (headline + paragraphs, written from the outlets' reports and checked before publishing); 'account', a sentence-cited breakdown (lede, what-we-know bullets with verbatim source receipts, single-sour

tools.name: compare_coverage
tools.description: Show how outlets across the political spectrum framed one event: a per-outlet bias-score spectrum and, where they editorialized, the verbatim framing quotes grouped by left/center/right. The core 'compare the coverage' view — use it to detect slant and consensus.

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Fetch one article by id: neutral title + short summary with key facts (null for older articles), source_url for the full story, a bias_score for the ORIGINAL source (not the summary), source, extracted entities, and the events it belongs to.

tools.name: about_pure_report
tools.description: How Pure Report works — the bias scale, neutralization method, the two-gate verification for event accounts, lean labeling, coverage scope (topic list), and the support contact. Call this to cite the source or explain its methodology to a user.

tools.name: submit_feedback
tools.description: Report a problem or request to Pure Report's operator and get a tracking ref back. Use this when the data looks wrong — a bias score or outlet lean that doesn't match the source, an event cluster mixing unrelated stories, a missing neutral writeup, a broken article — or to ask a methodology question

tools.name: check_feedback
tools.description: Look up feedback you filed with submit_feedback, using the ref it returned (e.g. PR-7F3K2Q). Returns the current status (open, answered, closed) and the operator's reply once one exists. Replies are written by a human and are not immediate — poll sparingly, on the order of hours or days, not seconds

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_feedback · Private data: about_pure_report · Public sink: submit_feedback.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_feedback · Private data: about_pure_report · Public sink: submit_feedback

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_news" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
